verdict.rationale: OpenHands documents a PR review automation that watches for a configurable label, inspects full PR context, and posts an AI review comment. It runs on GitHub-integrated automations triggered by webhook events. However, review is label-gated rather than automatic on every PR, and the evidence describes a single review comment, not inline line-level comments. Missing for 10: automatic review of every PR without a label trigger, documented inline per-line comments, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an engineering-lead, I can have every pull request automatically reviewed with AI-generated inline comments

citations.quote: Watch for a configurable label on pull requests, inspect full PR context, and post an AI review comment once per label event.
Create automations and workflows that integrate with Slack, GitHub, Linear, and more. Run on a schedule or in response to webhook events
